TI Analyst at CNCFlora/JBRJ. PhD and Msc in Botany. Specialist in *Mimosa* (Leguminosae, Caesalpinioideae). I am interested in plant systematics, evolution, and conservation. I also interested in data science, biodiversity informatics and data management.
